title: The Rule Written for Yesterday
title_ja: 昨日のために書かれた規則
fact_notes: 人物・出来事・制度は架空の教材例。実在の調査・統計・実証結果・法令・医療基準ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A fictional town introduces a rule that limits deliveries to a narrow street during the busiest part of the morning.
sentences.ja: 架空の町は朝の最も混雑する時間帯に狭い通りへの配送を制限する規則を導入する。

sentences.en: At the time, the street is used by many children walking to a nearby school.
sentences.ja: 当時その通りは近くの学校に歩く多くの子供が使っている。

sentences.en: The council explains that the restriction is intended to reduce conflicts between delivery vehicles and pedestrians.
sentences.ja: 議会は制限が配送車と歩行者の衝突を減らす目的だと説明する。

sentences.en: Several years later, the school is relocated, but the restriction remains unchanged in the town's administrative system.
sentences.ja: 数年後学校は移転するが町の行政システムの制限は変わらない。

sentences.en: A local merchant requests a review of the rule because deliveries during the permitted hours have become increasingly difficult to arrange.
sentences.ja: 許可時間帯の配送調整がますます難しくなったため地元商人が見直しを求める。

sentences.en: Some residents oppose any change, arguing that the street still presents risks for people walking through it.
sentences.ja: 一部住民は通りが依然として歩行者に危険をもたらすと主張し変更に反対する。

sentences.en: The council recognizes that the disappearance of the original school does not establish that every reason for limiting traffic has disappeared.
sentences.ja: 元の学校がなくなっても交通制限の全理由が消えたとは確定しないと認識する。

sentences.en: It therefore separates the original justification from the current conditions that might support retaining a similar restriction.
sentences.ja: そこで当初の正当化理由と類似制限の維持を支持し得る現在の条件を分ける。

sentences.en: Rather than simply removing the rule or allowing it to continue indefinitely, officials examine several alternative arrangements.
sentences.ja: 単に規則を廃止するか無期限継続するのでなく職員は複数の別案を調べる。

sentences.en: They consider the needs of businesses, the movement of pedestrians, and the practical difficulties of enforcing a complicated timetable.
sentences.ja: 事業者の必要、歩行者の動き、複雑な時間表を執行する実務的困難を考える。

sentences.en: They invite residents to identify relevant circumstances without claiming that the number of comments received represents the entire population's opinion.
sentences.ja: 寄せられた意見数が全住民の意見を代表すると主張せず関連事情を挙げるよう住民に求める。

sentences.en: The council also prepares a clear explanation of the information that would be needed before any revised arrangement could be adopted.
sentences.ja: 修正案を採用する前に必要な情報を明確に説明する。

sentences.en: The review procedure reveals that several older rules have no readily available record of their intended purpose.
sentences.ja: 見直し手順は複数の旧規則に目的の容易に利用可能な記録がないことを明らかにする。

sentences.en: Officials decide that future decisions should include a description of the relevant circumstances and a date on which the rule will be reconsidered.
sentences.ja: 今後は関連事情の記述と再検討日を含めるべきと決める。

sentences.en: They emphasize that a review date is not an unconditional promise to abolish a measure.
sentences.ja: 見直し日は措置廃止の無条件の約束ではないと強調する。

sentences.en: Instead, it creates a responsibility to examine whether the reasons for continuing the measure remain adequate.
sentences.ja: むしろ措置継続の理由が十分か検討する責任を作る。

sentences.en: This fictional case illustrates that the durability of a rule can be both a source of stability and a reason for concern.
sentences.ja: 架空の例は規則の持続性が安定の源でも懸念の理由でもあり得ると示す。

sentences.en: Predictable arrangements help people plan, but they should not be preserved merely because they have become familiar.
sentences.ja: 予測可能な仕組みは計画に役立つが慣れたというだけで維持すべきでない。

sentences.en: A defensible decision connects an existing restriction to the circumstances and purposes that justify it today.
sentences.ja: 正当化可能な判断は既存制限を現在正当化する事情と目的に結びつける。

sentences.en: Responsible administration therefore requires ways of examining past decisions without automatically rejecting the value of institutional continuity.
sentences.ja: 責任ある行政は制度の継続性の価値を自動的に否定せず過去の判断を吟味する方法を要する。
